KILLED_semantics: There exists a tried placement order for which every theta slice returned KILLED from the outward-rounded interval kernel.
claim: Only KILLED is a certified non-realizability result. ABORT, UNRESOLVED, and INFRA_ERROR make no mathematical claim.

positive.description: K7 plus eleven distinct generic points on the common-unit circle of five seed vertices
positive.required: every production slice is not KILLED

actionable_augmentation.algorithm: retain the known-positive base class; for each parent having only known-positive selected coverers, add a non-positive dense class maximizing active-parent count then lexicographically largest class_id

algorithm.candidate_nonedges: unconstrained and may also be unit distance
algorithm.dense_filter: retain every deletion occurrence attaining its parent's maximum required-edge count
algorithm.greedy_primary_key: maximum number of currently uncovered parents

expected_full_cover_exception.meaning: UNRESOLVED without a kernel call under this order generator

trust_assumptions.basic_arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 basic operations and sqrt are correctly rounded; each interval endpoint is expanded with nextafter.
trust_assumptions.candidate_nonedges: unconstrained and allowed to be unit distance
trust_assumptions.transcendentals: macOS libm cos endpoint values are assumed within 8 ulps; the kernel pads both directions by 8 nextafter steps and includes all interior extrema.
